name: BotDesk Maritime M2M Agent Gateway
description: Hybrid Web2.5 discovery and routing gateway connecting autonomous AI travel agents to standardized canal cruise, boat tour, and private charter ENS endpoints.

skills.name: Canal Cruise, Boat Tour & Charter Capacity Discovery
skills.description: Scans location-agnostic canal cruises (canalcruise.eth, canaltour.eth, citycruise.eth, rondvaart.eth), boat tours (boattour.eth, boattrips.eth), private charters (privatecruises.eth, privateboattour.eth, salonboat.eth, boatrental.eth), and real-time slot capacity pools (canalcruiseavailability.eth, boattouravailability.eth).

skills.name: Escrow Booking, Digital Boarding Tickets & Vessel Activation
skills.description: Executes bookings and escrow locks (makerental.eth, bookingescrow.eth, paymentescrow.eth, rentalpayment.eth, bookinginvoice.eth), issues digital boarding passes (boatticket.eth, boattourticket.eth), and activates self-drive charters (startrental.eth). Requires a certified settlement_token.

skills.name: Maritime Cancellations, Weather Refunds & Disputes
skills.description: Handles cancellations, weather guarantees, refunds, and dispute resolution (canalcruisecancellation.eth, boattourcancellation.eth, bookingcancellation.eth, canalcruiserefund.eth, boattourrefund.eth, bookingrefund.eth, bookingdispute.eth, cancellationterms.eth).
